item.immersive_trains.rotary_cannon.desc: Bangalad degdeg ah oo u shaqeysa buundo.
item.immersive_trains.bomb_bay.descripti: Dhulka TNT, ma burburin karto blocks laakiin dhaawac culus bay u geysaneysaa.
item.immersive_trains.telescope.descript: Nooc ka mid ah muusiga leh.
item.immersive_trains.heavy_crossbow.des: Crossbow culus oo leh xoog badan, wuxuu u baahan yahay fallaadho.
item.immersive_trains.airship.descriptio: Airships may not be the fastest vehicle, but they sure are easy to maneuver.
item.immersive_trains.cargo_airship.desc: Gaabis ah oo shidaal badan cunaya laakiin qaada kayd buuxa.
item.immersive_trains.warship.descriptio: Fortress duulaya, gaabis ah balse si xoogan u hubeysan.
item.immersive_trains.biplane.descriptio: Degdeg ah oo lagu kalsoonaan karo. Hubi in shaygaaga duulimaadku uu ku filan yahay.
item.immersive_trains.gyrodyne.descripti: Who needs an engine if one could power the aircraft with pure brawn? Give it a good push and off it flies!
item.immersive_trains.quadrocopter.descr: A masterwork of engineering! 4 rotors strapped to some bamboo. Perfect for building, and that's about it.
item.immersive_trains.bamboo_hopper.desc: Diyaarad weyn oo leh saddex kursi iyo pontoons si ammaan ah loogu dego biyaha.
immersive_trains.gyrodyne_target_reached: Xawaaraha rotorka ugu yar la gaadhay, diyaar u ah qaadista!
immersive_trains.tried_dismount: Mar kale riix si aad uga booddo!
immersive_trains.fuel.low: Waxaad ku dhowdahay inaad ka dhammaatid shidaalka!
immersive_trains.fat.out: Waxaad aad u gaajoon tahay inaad duusho!
option.immersive_trains.useThirdPersonBy: Hadafkoodu waa kamarada qofka saddexaad diyaarada.
option.immersive_trains.windThunderWeath: Dabayl dheeraad ah marka thunderka dhaco.
option.immersive_trains.useCustomKeybind: Isticmaal keydyo badan, waxay burburiyaan qaar ka mid ah mods.
option.immersive_trains.showHotbarEngine: Muuji kabka matooriga ee over hotbar.
option.immersive_trains.enableCrashBlock: Fur qarax wax u dhimi kara.
option.immersive_trains.crashDamage: Waxyeeleeya ciyaaryahanka markii uu shil galo.
option.immersive_trains.preventKillThrou: Ma dilayo ciyaaryahanka haddii uu shil galo.
option.immersive_trains.damagePerHealthP: Qiimayaasha sare waxay ka dhigayaan diyaaraduhu inay noqdaan kuwo adkeysi leh.

option.immersive_trains.dropUpgrades: Tuuri casriyeynta iyo habeynta, halkii aad ku badbaadin lahayd item-ka diyaarad.
option.immersive_trains.regenerateHealth: Si otomaatig ah ayaa caafimaadka dib u soo noqoshada markasta oo tick la siiyo, si u eg dhaqanka vanilla.
option.immersive_trains.requireShiftForR: Kaliya dayactir markaad hayso shift, haddii kale kaliya gal gaadiidka.
